Can I ask you something? They offered me a job in Amsterdam. I have two weeks to answer.
Two weeks is nothing. What would you do with your flat if you took it?
I'd keep it for a year, just in case. If I hated the city, I would at least have somewhere to come back to.
That is smart. Honestly, I'd be tempted. I can picture the whole thing.
So would you go, if it were you?
I don't know. Being far from my family would be the dealbreaker. My mother is already in Shanghai, so that is one continent too many.
If I were you, I would go and look at the city first. You can always say no after.
Fair. And if I found a role where I could stay based here and travel, I'd take it tomorrow.

Okay, so you asked me the question and I have been thinking about it all week. If I had a whole year and no job, I would not travel the world. Everybody says that, and honestly I think it is a long shot that anyone actually enjoys it. I would rent a small place near the sea, somewhere cheap, and I would finally learn to cook properly. If I could afford it, I would take a course. And I would say yes to everything for six months, which is not like me at all. The only dealbreaker would be being far from my sister. If she could not visit me, I would not go. What about you? Do not think too much, just answer.

Hi Ana, this is Michael from a recruitment studio in Amsterdam. I got your portfolio from a colleague and I have a question, not an offer, so there is no pressure here. We are building a team for a global brand and the role is fully remote. If you were open to it, you would stay based in Sao Paulo and you would travel four or five times a year. If the time difference were a problem, we could look at the hours, because half the team is in the Americas anyway. If you are curious, reply to my email and I will send you the details. If you are not, tell me that too, and I will stop bothering you.

Sam tells Ana that he has been offered a job in Amsterdam. Ana asks him what he would do if he took it. Sam explains that he would keep his flat here for a year, just in case. Ana admits that she would be tempted, but that being far from her family would be the dealbreaker. Sam says that if he were her, he would at least go and look at the city first.
